Virtual Visit Files

Exported from the Location Accreditation Binders library on SharePoint (Regions 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8) — "Guide to Policy & Procedure and Forms" folders are excluded, since that content lives on the Forms Reference page instead. Binders 1–5 are titled to match OP 840 (Morning Meeting, In-Service, Site Inspection, Joint Commission / Operations, SDS / Hazardous Materials) regardless of what the underlying SharePoint folder is actually named — the real folder name is shown under each title, and the link always opens that real folder. Item counts include files nested at any depth inside each folder. Virtual Visit Files are for uploading supporting documentation (ride-alongs, personnel records, photos & videos) during or after a virtual site visit.
